structured.answer: I didn't decide anything and I'm not moving money because of this page. I saw that Harel has many tracks with fees of about half a percent of the savings, and that the ones with high returns are almost all shares, but I couldn't tell which one is as safe as my deposit, so I'll ask my son or the bank.

stuck.why: Many columns of numbers on a black screen, plus the rings and coloured dots. I didn't know where to look.
Many rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no number, so I couldn't compare. I also wasn't sure if 13.7% over '3 שנים' is per year or for all three years together.
Two fees, 0.16% from savings and 1.47% from deposits. I didn't understand how much I would really pay.
Tired after six screens, so I stopped without reaching the rest of the products.
